Task.Name: Hold kickoff meeting with the Student Union and food bank
Develop project charter and scope statement
Develop schedule, budget and risk register
Project plan approved
Task.Notes: Milestone. The Student Union executive signs off the plan.

Task.Name: Reconcile funds and present donation to the food bank
Write final report and lessons learned
Design candidate routes and measure the 5 km course
Walk the route with Campus Facilities and Security
Submit special-event and road-use permit applications
City permit review (external)
Task.Notes: External wait with no team resource. Assumes a 10-working-day review. The ELC follows up twice a week.

Task.Name: Configure registration form, fees and waiver
Set up individual and team fundraising pages
Registration opens
Task.Notes: Milestone. Registration does not open until the permits are approved.

Task.Name: Close registration and confirm participant list
Collect sponsor logos and recognition details
Task.Notes: Logos are needed before the T-shirt order (7.3).

Task.Name: Develop marketing plan and key messages
Design posters, digital ads and social media templates
Run social media and campus outreach campaign
Run residence and club team challenge
Task.Notes: Starts 5 working days after the campaign launches (start-to-start link with a 5-day lag).

Task.Name: Run final promotion and race-week reminders
Define volunteer roles and numbers
Task.Notes: Marshal points come from the safety plan.

Task.Name: Build volunteer schedule and station assignments
Train and brief volunteers
Task.Notes: Held once the participant list is final, so stations can be staffed to actual numbers.

Task.Name: Order T-shirts and medals (incl. supplier lead time)
Task.Notes: Mostly supplier lead time, so the ELC is assigned at 20%.

Task.Name: Book chip-timing service and race bibs
Arrange water stations, barriers, signage and first aid
Set up course and start/finish area
Hold race, awards ceremony and sponsor recognition
Race day completed
Task.Notes: Milestone. Deadline set to the target race date, Fri Apr 16, 2027.

Task.Name: Tear down course and return rentals
Publish official results and thank participants
